Upgrade your system with high-performance RAM and memory in Pakistan, available at unbeatable prices from PakByte.pk. Whether you're a gamer, editor, or casual user, we offer DDR4 and DDR5 memory modules for desktops, laptops, and gaming rigs.

Browse top brands trusted for speed and reliability, including Corsair, Kingston (Fury, HyperX), G.SKILL, XPG, TEAMGROUP (T-Force), and Lexar — with options ranging from 8GB to 64GB, high-frequency kits, and RGB lighting support.

  • Gaming RAM with heat spreaders and RGB sync

  • Laptop SODIMM memory upgrades

  • High-speed DDR5 kits for next-gen builds

  • Dual-channel and single-stick configurations
